interface.title: Gene Expression Visualizer (flask-scrna-spermatogenesis)
interface.field: Reproductive biology / single-cell transcriptomics (mouse spermatogenesis scRNA-seq)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploratory analysis and checking hypotheses on a bundled expression table (in this run a synthetic stand-in for the app's pseudobulk dataset)
interface.what_it_is_for: Give it a list of gene symbols, by uploading a file or typing them, and it plots their expression across nine spermatogenesis stages (SSC to Sperm) as a per-gene line plot, a summary-statistics plot and a row-clustered heatmap, with an optional z-score per gene.

data.source: synthetic stand-in expression matrix (replacing the app's missing sceRNA.csv) plus an uploaded test gene list
data.note: The expression matrix (TP10K per stage: SSC, Spermatogonia, Leptotene, Zygotene, Pachytene, Diplotene, RoundSpermatid, ElongatingSpermatid, Sperm) is a synthetic stand-in for the app's sceRNA.csv, seeded with marker-like profiles. Stage peaks and clusters reported below therefore show how the tool displays seeded values, not real biology. Gene lists came from the provided gene_list.txt and from names I typed. gene_list.txt has 9 symbols: Sycp3, Piwil1, Acr, Tnp1, Prm1, Prm2, Dazl, Ddx4 and Actb. Only 7 were plotted. Ddx4 (a missing SSC value in the table) and Actb (constant at 25.0, zero variance) were removed without any message. The page's own example file (/download, input.txt) is missing on the server and returns FileNotFoundError.

features.name: Gene-list entry form with two input modes and a normalization toggle
features.general: Give a list of identifiers either as an uploaded one-per-line file or as typed comma-separated text, choose raw or standardized values, and submit. The list is matched exactly against a built-in table. Items that are absent, have a missing value or are constant are dropped without any report of which were dropped or why.
features.specific: Choose File (gene_file) or type into 'gene_names', optionally tick 'Use Z-Score Normalization', press Submit. Symbols must match case exactly (e.g. 'Sycp3'). Spaces after commas are optional. If both inputs are filled, the file is used. Genes absent from the table, genes with a NaN and zero-variance genes are dropped without notice; e.g. Ddx4 and Actb from gene_list.txt. Output follows the table's row order, not input order. Fewer than 2 surviving genes crashes the page. Per the source (app.py:43), the line-plot legend is suppressed when more than 10 genes survive, so for larger panels check the heatmap rows instead.
steps: choose a file or type comma-separated names
check the legend (or heatmap rows if more than 10 genes) to see which genes survived

features.name: Per-item trajectory plot over ordered stages with raw/z-score axis

There is one legend entry per gene, in the table's row order. Per the source (app.py:43), the legend is not drawn when more than 10 genes are plotted.

features.name: Row-clustered heatmap with dendrogram, columns kept in order
features.general: Show items × ordered conditions as a heatmap standardized per row, with the rows grouped by hierarchical clustering and the condition order left unchanged, so items with similar timing sit next to each other.
features.specific: seaborn clustermap (z_score=0, col_cluster=False, cmap 'vlag'). Gene rows are reordered by the dendrogram, the stage columns stay in order, and a colour bar is shown. It is always row-z-scored, whatever the checkbox says.
